headlines.title: AOC says she hasn’t ruled out 2028 presidential run, talks about freezing her eggs
headlines.description: The New York representative said “anything is possible at this juncture” when asked whether she’d thought about running for Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer’s seat.

headlines.title: As Francesca Hong surged, Democratic rivals held their fire: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, I take a look at the lack of attacks Francesca Hong has faced on the Wisconsin airwaves. Plus, Allan Smith dives into an unexpected bipartisan pairing in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: Connecticut Democrat challenging incumbent says leaders need to recognize ‘when to pass the torch’
headlines.description: The fight over generational change heats up in Tuesday’s Democratic primary race in Connecticut's first congressional district. Former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin (D-Conn.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his campaign challenging incumbent Rep. John Larson (D-Conn.).

headlines.title: Connecticut Democrat facing primary challenger running on a ‘record of accomplishment & achievement’
headlines.description: Rep. John Larson (D-Conn.) joins Meet the Press NOW as he faces a primary challenge for the first time since he was elected in 1998. Rep. Larson discusses his record in Congress and how he will deliver for his district.

headlines.title: Democratic Minnesota Senate candidate says her campaign is about ‘the many versus the money’
headlines.description: Internal divisions between progressive and moderate Democrats grow ahead of tomorrow’s closely watched primary for Minnesota’s Senate seat. Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan (D) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her bid for U.S. Senate.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump order aims to cut number of diseases all children should be vaccinated against from 18 to 11
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: Sen. Jim Banks says Rep. Max Miller should drop his re-election bid if allegations are true
headlines.description: The Indiana Republican is the latest GOP lawmaker to call on Miller, R-Ohio, to step aside in the wake of domestic violence allegations, which he has denied.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed says he hopes to campaign with Obama after ‘warm and inspiring’ call
headlines.description: Top Democrats, including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer, have lined up behind El-Sayed after supporting his rival in the primary.

headlines.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread
headlines.description: Former President Joe Biden’s son, Hunter Biden, said his father’s cancer is spreading in what he described as a “very debilitating” state.

headlines.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general after weeks of uncertainty
headlines.description: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as U.S. attorney general early Saturday in a mostly party-line vote, capping off weeks of uncertainty and despite bipartisan concerns about his ability to run a Justice Department independent of President Donald Trump’s impulses.
